# Casper

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `core` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 16 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Public shop: public pages captured signed out. Signed-in screens were not captured..

Captured 2026-11-22, signed out (public pages only; login, signup, checkout, and subscribe were not followed). Themes: core.

Signed-out capture of the public Casper shop at [https://casper.com](https://casper.com) on 2026-11-22. Desktop 1440 by 900, `devicePixelRatio` 2. The page is `#ffffff`, body type is Calibre, and the wordmark and footer are navy `#1e306e`.

Photographed the homepage, The One mattress, and the empty login and signup walls. Header, footer, and the public links those controls open are in [site-tree.md](site-tree.md). Colours and type are in [tokens.json](tokens.json). `catalog.json` was left alone. `webapps-manifest.json` was left alone. `login-extracted` was not flipped.

Stopped at the login wall, the signup wall, the footer subscribe form, and the cart. Nothing was typed. No form was submitted. No identity provider was clicked. No captcha was solved. Add to cart was not clicked. Cart was not opened.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page white and the bar navy.** The page is `#ffffff` and the 53px announcement bar is `#1e306e`. [screenshots/home-light-1440.png](screenshots/home-light-1440.png)
- **Use a 32px pill for the sale and the cart.** Shop sale is lime `#eaffac`. Add to cart is `#012169`. Both have a `32px` radius. [screenshots/product-light-1440.png](screenshots/product-light-1440.png)
- **Stop at the empty account walls.** Login asks for email and password. Sign up asks for name, email, and password. Create account was not clicked. [screenshots/signup-light-1440.png](screenshots/signup-light-1440.png)
